g.text: A read gives a haplotype only if it covers every base of the window. 4 of 6 reads do.

text.style: font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; fill: #1a1a1a

g.text: The name of a haplotype is its content against the reference. “=” means identical to the reference.

text.style: font-weight: 700; font-size: 7.2px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans', sans-serif; text-anchor: start; fill: #1a1a1a
